title: NASA's Boeing CFT Crew Arrival at Kennedy Space Center
description: NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams return to the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Tuesday, May 28, in preparation for NASA’s Boeing Crew Flight Test following a scrub of the first launch attempt on May 6. As part of NASA’s Commercial Crew Program, Boeing’s Starliner spacecraft is scheduled to launch atop a United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket to the International Space Station at 12:25 p.m. EDT on Saturday, June 1. The Atlas V will lift off from Space Launch Complex-41 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
